summary: Iteration 2 backend-only testing for Cak Mad Quiz API. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_cakmad_api.py with 22 new tests covering Players (public list, admin create/patch/delete auth gating with multipart), Friends scope on leaderboard (unauth + malformed/invalid bearer returns [] not 401), Friends endpoints (list/follow/unfollow/search require 401 without auth), Files pass-through (404 for non-existent paths), and new Mongo indexes (users.username unique sparse, friendships (follower_id, following_id) unique, players.player_id unique). All iteration-1 regression tests still pass. Final result: 38/38 PASSED against public URL https://ballgame-id.preview.emergentagent.com.

minor.issue: Odd expression `{"deleted_at": None} if False else {"deleted_at": {"$exists": False}}` on line 427 — the `if False else` is dead code and misleading. Harmless but should be cleaned up to just `{"deleted_at": {"$exists": False}}`.

`included_in_quiz: bool` as a non-Form bare parameter in a POST/PATCH-style endpoint — FastAPI treats it as a query param. Works, but inconsistent with POST /admin/players which uses Form. Consider making it a JSON body or Query(...) explicitly for API clarity.

Query validator `min_length=2` is declared, but auth Depends is resolved before query validation, so q='a' returns 401 instead of 422. Not a bug, but documented in test_friends_search_q_min_length (accepts both).

action_items: Optional: clean up `{"deleted_at": None} if False else {...}` dead-code branch in players_list (server.py line 427).
Optional: tighten PATCH /api/admin/players/{player_id} parameter style — currently `included_in_quiz` is a query param; could be body or explicit Query(...).
Carried over from iter 1: add Literal enums on ScoreSubmit.category; narrow CORS allow_origins for production.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin bootstrap: `is_admin` is granted to the first user to sign in via `count_documents({'is_admin': True}) == 0`. There is no admin-promotion endpoint — if the first-ever user is a test/throwaway account, promoting a different user requires a direct Mongo update. Consider a one-time env-based admin bootstrap (e.g., ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist on first exchange).

Object Storage init: `init_storage()` caches `storage_key` in a module global. On transient failure during startup it is logged but not retried; subsequent `put_object` calls will attempt re-init on each request (fine). Still, if INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL or EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is wrong, player photo uploads silently 500 — add a readiness check or surface this in /health.

File passthrough: GET /api/files/{full_path:path} proxies every request through the backend (no streaming). For large images this blocks a worker thread; use `httpx.AsyncClient.stream` instead of synchronous `requests` and consider edge caching headers (Cache-Control).

Friends scope leaderboard includes the current user's own id in the $in list (good), but it reuses the `scores` best_scores collection which already filters by mode — OK. However there is no pagination/skip beyond `limit`; cursor-based pagination would be better once data grows.
players_create: photo extension derived from filename only; no MIME sniffing. A client could upload an executable with a .jpg extension. Low risk since served via object storage, but worth noting.

username collision: `new_username()` has ~2.2B space (36^6) but no explicit retry on IntegrityError from the unique sparse index. Collision is astronomically unlikely but a try/except with regenerate would be defensive.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_cakmad_api.py (extended with TestPlayers, TestLeaderboardFriendsScope, TestFriends, TestFiles, and 3 new index tests in TestMongoIndexes)
seed_data_creation: None. All iteration-2 tests only hit public endpoints or verify auth-gated endpoints return 401 — no documents written to Mongo. Index metadata is read-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No valid Google session_id is available in this environment, so authenticated flows (admin photo upload, friend follow with real target, friends-scope leaderboard with populated friendships) cannot be end-to-end validated. The suite only verifies 401/404 boundaries and public read endpoints. For full flow coverage, a valid Emergent OAuth session_id must be obtained via the frontend redirect; then POST /api/auth/session → use session_token to: (1) seed a player via POST /api/admin/players multipart (first user is admin), (2) follow another seeded user via POST /api/friends/follow {code|email}, (3) submit scores and verify friends-scope leaderboard returns only self+followed. Public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Mongo creds read from /app/backend/.env.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. All iteration-2 features behave per spec: Players public read + admin-gated writes, Friends auth-gated 401, Friends scope on leaderboard silently returns [] for unauth/invalid-bearer (per intent), Files passthrough 404 on missing objects, and all three new indexes (users.username unique+sparse, friendships composite unique, players.player_id unique) are present.
